answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Corning Chairman, CEO and President, speaking to Fox News Digital (published 2026-07-01)
answer.new_information: Management says Corning is in its fastest growth period in 175 years and will probably double in size over the coming years, with almost all new hires in advanced manufacturing and a significant part in the US. The record gives no period for the doubling, no revenue or headcount base, and no definition of size. The 3,000-job and tenfold-capacity figures in the article are Fox's restatement of the earlier NVIDIA partnership, not claims made in this record.
answer.reason: No stored pieces or catalog questions were supplied, so there is no argument to update. The record is a sizeless, undated management pickup: 'coming years' and 'double our size' have no stated period or measure, so it moves no number, probability or condition. It would not change a position on its own and does not carry an investment judgement that needs a new question.
